item.title: ICE crackdown in Minnesota changed the race for open U.S. Senate seat
item.description: President Trump's immigration crackdown in Minnesota earlier this year is a key issue going into that state's competitive Democratic primary for an open U.S. Senate seat.
item.content:encoded: President Trump's immigration crackdown in Minnesota earlier this year is a key issue going into that state's competitive Democratic primary for an open U.S. Senate seat.

item.title: Why is Texas Gov. Greg Abbott pausing permits to build new data centers?
item.description: Texas is on track to become the country's largest data center market. But the governor has effectively issued a pause on new centers until the state can audit their energy and water usage.
item.content:encoded: Texas is on track to become the country's largest data center market. But the governor has effectively issued a pause on new centers until the state can audit their energy and water usage.

item.title: After his Reflecting Pool vandalism case is dismissed, David Hearn looks for closure
item.description: The ex-Olympian accused of damaging the reflecting pool tells NPR the experience has been "Orwellian" and "Kafkaesque." And it's not over yet: His lawyers are fighting to close the case permanently.

item.title: The FAA wants to reboot the nation's airspace. This airline shows how it might work
item.description: When Alaska Airlines wanted to optimize its operations, it turned to a small startup called Air Space Intelligence. Now the FAA has hired the company for a major reboot of the entire U.S. airspace.

item.title: An arts school where Epstein allegedly preyed on students reveals decades of abuse
item.description: In a new report, former Interlochen students detail some 70 allegations of sexual abuse by nearly 50 adults employed or affiliated with the school. One of the former students tells his story to NPR.

item.title: Minneapolis volunteer group connects singles passionate about environmentalism
item.description: A volunteer group in Minneapolis is trading dating apps for garden tools and invasive plants, as singles passionate about environmentalism work together to restore a park while making new connections.

item.title: Crews battle wildfires in western U.S. and Canada
item.description: There have been 183 new wildfires, including eight large ones, across the U.S. since Saturday, the National Interagency Fire Center reported on Sunday.

item.title: Nearly 30 years after Tupac's death, the trial over his murder will finally begin
item.description: In 2023, police charged Duane Davis, also known as "Keefe D," with organizing Tupac Shakur's murder in 1996. Author Ben Westhoff discusses Davis' trial that begins Monday.
